bio_en: Yeghishe Topchian was born in Alexandropol in 1872 and graduated from the town school in 1890; he later studied at the teachers' institute in Petrograd (1898) and social sciences in Berlin (1900). Returning to the Caucasus in 1902, he settled in Tiflis and devoted himself to public work and journalism, sitting from 1904 on the editorial boards of Haraj and its successors and holding important party posts. During the 1909 persecutions of the Dashnaks he moved to Erzurum, where he became inspector of the national schools and founded the Erzurum 'Haraj'. He was killed there, a loss mourned on both sides of the border; Shavarsh Misakian took over the paper after his murder.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Year of his murder not stated in #334; #280 implies before 1911.
